title: No authentication or authorisation on remote control API
detail: All WCF operations (WriteTag, UploadFirmware, QueryHistory) are callable anonymously over plain HTTP on every interface. Any host on the OT network can change PLC setpoints or stage firmware.

title: Modbus response parsing trusts device-supplied byte count
detail: ParseReadResponse uses the byte-count field without checking it against the received length or the MBAP length; a single read() is assumed to return a full frame and transaction IDs are never matched. A rogue or spoofed slave can cause crashes or stale/misattributed process values.

title: Tag 'Writable' flag and engineering limits not enforced
detail: WriteTag writes any tag, including read-only process values, with no range check; value/scale overflow wraps silently into the register.

title: Firmware updates are not authenticated
detail: Integrity relies on an MD5 file delivered inside the same bundle; there is no signature, so anyone able to upload can deliver arbitrary firmware. No rollback protection or update audit.

title: Device maintenance passwords exposed through the public API contract
detail: DeviceInfo.MaintenancePassword is a DataMember returned by ListDevices to any caller.

title: No security event logging / audit trail
detail: Setpoint writes, firmware uploads, authentication failures and configuration changes are not recorded as security events; exceptions are swallowed.

title: Binaries are not signed
detail: Assemblies and the service executable are neither strong-named nor Authenticode-signed; integrity of the installed product cannot be verified.

title: No vulnerability-handling process artefacts
detail: No SBOM, no coordinated vulnerability disclosure policy (SECURITY.md), no defined support period, no security-update distribution channel, no CI security gates.

cra: Annex I Part I (2)(b) secure by default
title: Default credentials shipped in configuration
detail: admin / Admin@123 and the SQL 'sa' account are shipped as defaults; nothing forces a change at commissioning.
